page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-8-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 63.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. This high memory density aligns the server with memory-intensive workloads.

For storage, the instance utilizes NVMe SSD technology, though the specific local storage capacity is not defined in the configuration. It includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no graphics processing units integrated into this configuration, meaning all computational tasks rely entirely on the dedicated x86_64 CPU cores.

From a resource allocation perspective, the z4d-highmem-8-highlssd offers a high density of memory relative to its vCPU count, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring substantial RAM without the overhead of a high core count. The combination of dedicated vCPUs, NVMe SSD storage, and 63.0 GB of RAM makes this server suitable for database hosting, memory-cached applications, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that demand consistent CPU performance and low-latency storage access.
